_what: The shape of the meditation session, as published, used to check that this project's band-power pipeline reaches the same reading of the same recording.
_source: Published in the case study 'Session 01: the meditation that peaked at minute three'.
_why_shape_not_values: Exact band-share percentages move substantially with preprocessing choices (whether slow drift is removed first, and whether a window's share is power-weighted or averaged across epochs). The direction and the timing of a change survive all of those choices; the decimals do not. So the test asserts the shape, which is what the published claim actually rests on.
